exposure: Anterior colporrhaphy with concomitant transobturator tape (TOT)
cohort: Women diagnosed with cystocele-associated stress urinary incontinence.
finding: Transvaginal mesh was not superior to native tissue repair, suggesting that anterior colporrhaphy and transobturator tape (TOT) is an appropriate alternative to four-armed transobturator mesh (TOM) for concomitant correction of SUI and cystocele.
